claims: The 2026 tax filing deadline for most Americans is April 15, 2026.
Taxpayers can file an automatic extension to October 15, 2026.
Taxpayers must still pay any estimated taxes owed by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file 2025 federal tax returns.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to pay any tax due.
April 15, 2026 is the last day to file for an automatic 6-month extension.
October 15, 2026 is the extended deadline to submit tax returns.
May 1, 2026 is the special deadline for residents in disaster-prone areas.
Form 4868 can be used to request an extension.
Form 4868 only extends time to file, not time to pay.
Special rules for extensions apply to military members stationed outside the U.S.
